Who we are

Turning project complexity into a competitive advantage

Construction margins are won or lost in the gaps between head office, procurement and site. Progress lives in one system, costs in another, and the drawings everyone works from in a third. By the time the monthly report is compiled, the decisions it should inform are already two weeks late.

Fynsignal closes those gaps. We are a data and automation consultancy that modernizes how construction projects get delivered: connecting the systems you already run into one reliable data layer, automating the reporting and approvals that consume project hours, and putting AI copilots to work on the documents that slow every project down.

We start small, prove value with a measurable pilot, and scale what works — so transformation becomes a sequence of funded, verified wins rather than a leap of faith.

Written first

Scope, findings and pricing in writing before anything starts.

One team, engineering and data

Consultants who speak both site reality and data architecture.

No new licences

We build on the ERP, CDE and analytics stack you already pay for.

Handed over, not held

Services

Four ways we modernize how construction work gets done

Every engagement starts from a workflow your teams already struggle with — then we make that workflow measurably faster, cheaper or safer.

BIM & Digital Twins

One living model from design through handover.

  • Common Data Environment integration and clean as-built handover data
  • 4D/5D dashboards linking model progress to cost and schedule
  • Automated clash detection and design-review workflows
  • Digital twin of the completed asset for operations readiness

Typical outcome: one source of truth for design status

Predictive Equipment Maintenance

Fix it before it fails, plan it before it hurts.

  • Sensor and IoT data pipelines from site plant and equipment
  • Failure-prediction models for critical site equipment
  • Maintenance planning integrated with spares and site schedules
  • Alerting that reaches the right engineer, not a generic inbox

Typical outcome: fewer unplanned stoppages, lower OPEX

Project Controls Analytics

Earned value that updates itself, forecasts you trust.

  • Automated EVM from field, procurement and finance data
  • Cost and schedule forecasting with trend and risk signals
  • Progress measurement straight from site and drone data
  • Executive dashboards one click from the raw numbers

Typical outcome: decisions based on this week, not last month

AI Copilots for Engineers

Project knowledge that answers back.

  • Document intelligence over specs, drawings and contracts
  • RAG assistants trained on your project knowledge base
  • Tender and RFQ analysis with draft compliance matrices
  • Automated minutes-to-actions and deliverable drafting

Typical outcome: days of document work reduced to hours

How we work

Delivered in verified steps, not year-long programmes

  1. 1

    Diagnose

    A two-week data and maturity assessment across site, commercial and planning systems. You get written findings, a prioritized roadmap and a fixed price for the first move.

    2 weeks · written roadmap

  2. 2

    Pilot

    One workflow, one team, one measurable baseline. We automate or instrument a single process end-to-end and prove the delta against the numbers you do today.

    4–6 weeks · measurable baseline

  3. 3

    Integrate

    We connect the pilot into the systems you already run — ERP, CDE, BIM 360, Primavera, SAP, Tally — so data flows once and gets reused everywhere.

    No rip-and-replace

  4. 4

    Scale

    Rollout with governance, training and documentation. Your team owns the pipelines, dashboards and models — we stay on call, not on payroll.

    Full handover, you own it
